Blocks.Name: Counter
Blocks.Description:
Use counters to give feedback about the current count of several elements.

Very useful on dashboards or summary pages.

Add content to the placeholder, then, set up the orientation and Height of the Block.

Inputs.Name: Orientation
Inputs.Description: Set the orientation.

Inputs.Name: Height
Inputs.Description: Height of the block, use Pixel units.

Inputs.Name: ExtendedClass
Inputs.Description: Add custom style classes to this Block.

Placeholders.Name: Content
Placeholders.Description: Drag your content to this placeholder.

Blocks.Name: ProgressBar
Blocks.Description:
Progress bar with indication of a current action in percentage values.

Configure the variable that defines the percentage. You can also change the shape, size, orientation and color of the ProgressBar.

Inputs.Name: Percentage
Inputs.Description: Percentage to display, you can use functions or local variables.

Inputs.Name: Color
Inputs.Description: Set the background color.

Inputs.Name: Shape
Inputs.Description: Set the shape.

Inputs.Name: Size
Inputs.Description: Set the size.

Inputs.Name: IsInline
Inputs.Description:
Set the orientation of the value placeholder. 

When true, the value placeholder will be placed at the end of the line and the label placeholder is hidden.

When False, value and label of the placeholder will be placed over the line.

Inputs.Name: ExtendedClass
Inputs.Description: Add custom style classes to this Block.

Placeholders.Name: Title
Placeholders.Description: Use this placeholder to set your title.

Placeholders.Name: Value
Placeholders.Description: Drag your content to this placeholder.

Blocks.Name: ProgressCircle
Blocks.Description: Easy to create circular or semi circular progress indicators. Create your custom content and put it inside the content placeholder.

Inputs.Name: Progress
Inputs.Description: Percentage to display, you can use functions or local variables.

Inputs.Name: ProgressColor
Inputs.Description: The color of the stroke on progress circle.

Inputs.Name: TrailColor
Inputs.Description: The color of the empty part of the progress circle.

Inputs.Name: CircleThickness
Inputs.Description: The thickness of the circle that marks the progress.

Inputs.Name: AnimateInitialProgress
Inputs.Description: Animate the progress circle from zero to progress value.

Inputs.Name: IsSemiCircle
Inputs.Description: Change the type of progress bar from circle to semi circle.

Inputs.Name: AdvancedFormat
Inputs.Description:
Allow for more options beyond what it's provided through the input parameters.

Example:
"{
    duration: 1400,
    easing: 'bounce',
}"

For more information visit: 
https://kimmobrunfeldt.github.io/progressbar.js/

Placeholders.Name: Content
Placeholders.Description:
Drag your content here.
You can use an Expression to display the Progress value.

Avoid using it in large forms.

In the parameters, specify the initial active tab, along with the Tabs orientation and justification.

Inputs.Name: ActiveTab
Inputs.Description:
The default tab that is considered opened.
By default, the active tab should match with DataTab of the TabHeaderItem and TabContentItem.
If you want to use this as an index reference, you should set the ActiveTabAsIndex parameter as True.

Examples:
    ActiveTab = "", the first tab is active.
    ActiveTab = "tab-two" and the DataTab (TabHeaderItem, TabContentItem) = "tab-two", that tab will be active.
    ActiveTab = 2 and ActiveTabAsIndex = True, if the third tab exists, it will be active.
    ActiveTab = "Tabs2Developer" and ActiveTabAsIndex = True, the non-digits will be ignored and if the third tab exists, it will be active.

Inputs.Name: Orientation
Inputs.Description:
If Vertical, the header will be displayed side by side to the content.
If Horizontal, header will be displayed above the content.

Inputs.Name: IsJustified
Inputs.Description: When set to true the Items are evenly distributed in the space available.

Inputs.Name: IsRight
Inputs.Description:
When set to true, aligns the Tabs Header items to right. 
This will only go into effect if the Orientation parameter is set to Vertical.

Inputs.Name: ActiveTabAsIndex
Inputs.Description:
Set to True if the ActiveTab value is an index. By default, the ActiveTab value is handled as a text reference.

Examples:
    ActiveTabAsIndex = True and ActiveTab = 2, if the third tab exists, it will be active.
    ActiveTabAsIndex = True and ActiveTab = "Tabs2Developer", the non-digits will be ignored and if the third tab exists, it will be active.
    ActiveTabAsIndex = False and ActiveTab = "tab-two", if the DataTab (TabHeaderItem, TabContentItem) = "tab-two", that tab will be active.
